units.zh: 梁書卷第二十七 列傳第二十一
units.en: Book of Liang, Volume 27, Biographies, Number 21
units.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 27, Biographies, Number 21

units.zh: 陸倕 到洽 明山賓 殷鈞 陸襄
units.en: Lu Chui; Dao Qia; Ming Shanbin; Yin Jun; and Lu Xiang
units.literal: Lu Chui, Dao Qia, Ming Shanbin, Yin Jun, and Lu Xiang

units.zh: 陸倕字佐公，吳郡吳人也。
units.en: Lu Chui, styled Zuogong, came from Wu county in Wu commandery.
units.literal: Lu Chui, styled Zuogong, was a man of Wu county in Wu commandery.

units.zh: 晉太尉玩六世孫。
units.en: He was a sixth-generation descendant of Lu Wan, who had served Jin as Grand Commandant.
units.literal: He was the sixth-generation descendant of Wan, Grand Commandant of Jin.

units.zh: 祖子真，宋東陽太守。
units.en: His grandfather Zizhen had been Administrator of Dongyang under the Liu Song.
units.literal: His grandfather Zizhen was Administrator of Dongyang under Song.

units.zh: 父慧曉，齊太常卿。
units.en: His father Huixiao had served Qi as Minister of Ceremonies.
units.literal: His father Huixiao was Minister of Ceremonies of Qi.

units.zh: 倕少勤學，善屬文。
units.en: From boyhood Chui studied hard and showed a gift for writing.
units.literal: Chui from youth studied diligently and was skilled at literary composition.

units.zh: 於宅內起兩間茅屋，杜絕往來，晝夜讀書，如此者數載。
units.en: He built two thatched rooms inside his home, shut out all visitors, and read day and night like this for several years.
units.literal: Within his residence he built two thatched rooms, cut off all comings and goings, and read day and night in this way for several years.

units.zh: 所讀一遍，必誦於口。
units.en: Whatever he read through once, he would recite aloud from memory.
units.literal: Whatever he read once, he invariably recited aloud.

units.zh: 嘗借人《漢書》，失《五行志》四卷，乃暗寫還之，略無遺脫。
units.en: Once he borrowed someone's Book of Han and lost four fascicles of the Treatise on the Five Phases; he copied them from memory and returned the book, omitting almost nothing.
units.literal: Once he borrowed someone's Book of Han and lost four juan of the Treatise on the Five Phases; he then copied them out from memory and returned the book, with scarcely a single omission.

units.zh: 幼爲外祖張岱所異，岱常謂諸子曰：「此兒汝家之陽元也。」
units.en: As a boy he impressed his maternal grandfather Zhang Dai, who often told his sons, "This child is the Wei Shu of your family."
units.literal: In childhood he was regarded as extraordinary by his maternal grandfather Zhang Dai, who often told his sons, "This boy is the Yangyuan of your family."

units.zh: 年十七，舉本州秀才。
units.en: At seventeen he was nominated as a provincial xiucai.
units.literal: At age seventeen he was nominated as a xiucai of his province.

units.zh: 刺史竟陵王子良開西邸延英俊，倕亦預焉。
units.en: When the provincial inspector, Prince Ziliang of Jingling, opened his western lodge to gather talented men, Chui was among those invited.
units.literal: The Inspector, Prince Ziliang of Jingling, opened a western lodge to gather outstanding men, and Chui was also among them.

units.zh: 辟議曹從事參軍、廬陵王法曹行參軍。
units.en: He was recruited as aide in the Bureau of Deliberation and as acting aide in the legal bureau under the Prince of Luling.
units.literal: He was summoned as Aide-de-Camp of the Bureau of Deliberation and Acting Aide of the Legal Bureau under the Prince of Luling.

units.zh: 天監初，爲右軍安成王外兵參軍，轉主簿。
units.en: Early in the Tianjian era he served as outer-army aide to the Right Army under the Prince of Ancheng, then became chief clerk.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianjian he served as Outer Army Aide to the Right Army under the Prince of Ancheng, then was transferred to Chief Clerk.

units.zh: 倕與樂安任昉友善，爲《感知己賦》以贈昉，昉因此名以報之曰：「信偉人之世篤，本侯服於陸鄉。
units.en: Chui was close friends with Ren Fang of Le'an and wrote "Fu on Perceiving a True Friend" as a gift to him. Fang answered with a rhapsody of his own, opening: "Truly steadfast among the great men of our age—your roots lie in the marquis lands of Lu township.
units.literal: Chui was on friendly terms with Ren Fang of Le'an and wrote "Fu on Perceiving a True Friend" to present to Fang. Fang therefore composed a rhapsody in reply by name, saying, "Truly steadfast among great men of the age, rooted originally in the marquisate lands of Lu township.

units.zh: 緬風流與道素，襲袞衣與繡裳。
units.en: Far back runs your elegant bearing and moral purity; you inherit court robes and embroidered gowns.
units.literal: Far-reaching in elegant bearing and moral purity, inheriting court robes and embroidered gowns.

units.zh: 還伊人而世載，並三駿而龍光。
units.en: You look back to that man of old, passed down through generations, and stand with three steeds in dragon brilliance.
units.literal: Turning back to that man of old, passed down through generations; together with three steeds, dragon brilliance.

units.zh: 過龍津而一息，望鳳條而曾翔。
units.en: You crossed Dragon Ford and paused for breath; you gazed at the phoenix branch where you once soared.
units.literal: Crossing Dragon Ford he paused for breath; gazing at the phoenix branch he once soared.

units.zh: 彼白玉之雖潔，此幽蘭之信芳。
units.en: Though white jade may be pure, this secluded orchid is truly fragrant.
units.literal: Though that white jade is pure, this secluded orchid is truly fragrant.

units.zh: 思在物而取譬，非鬥斗之能量。
units.en: Your thought dwells in things when you draw comparisons—not the petty measure of a dipper's worth.
units.literal: Thought dwells in things when drawing comparisons—not the petty measure of a dipper's capacity.

units.zh: 匹聳峙於東岳，比凝厲於秋霜。
units.en: You match Mount Tai looming in the east; you compare to autumn frost in its stern chill.
units.literal: A match for Mount Tai looming in the east; comparable to autumn frost in its stern chill.

units.zh: 不一飯以妄過，每三錢以投渭。
units.en: You would not accept a meal for a reckless lapse; again and again you cast three coins into the Wei.
units.literal: He would not take a meal for a reckless lapse; thrice he cast three coins into the Wei.

units.zh: 匪蒙袂之敢嗟，豈溝壑之能衣。
units.en: You would not dare lament like one covering his sleeve; how could a gully or ravine clothe you?
units.literal: Not daring to lament like one covering his sleeve; how could a gully or ravine clothe him?

units.zh: 旣蘊藉其有餘，又淡然而無味。
units.en: You are richly stored within, yet bland and without savour.
units.literal: Both richly stored within and yet bland, without savour.

units.zh: 得意同乎卷懷，違方似乎仗氣。
units.en: When pleased, you are like one who rolls up his aspirations; when at odds with the world, you seem to rely on sheer spirit.
units.literal: When pleased, he was like one who rolls up his aspirations; when at odds with the world, he seemed to rely on sheer spirit.

units.zh: 類平叔而靡雕，似子雲之不樸。
units.en: You resemble Ping Shu yet without carving; you resemble Zi Yun yet not unadorned.
units.literal: Like Ping Shu yet without carving; like Zi Yun yet not unadorned.

units.zh: 冠衆善而貽操，綜羣言而名學。
units.en: You crown all excellence and bestow your integrity; you synthesize the schools of learning and make a name in scholarship.
units.literal: He crowns all excellence and bestows his integrity; he synthesizes the schools of learning and makes a name in scholarship.

units.zh: 折高、戴於后臺，異鄒、顏乎董幄。
units.en: You bend Gao and Dai to the rear hall; you set Zou and Yan apart within Dong Zhongshu's curtain.
units.literal: He bends Gao and Dai to the rear hall; he sets Zou and Yan apart within Dong Zhongshu's curtain.

units.zh: 采三《詩》於河間，訪九師於淮曲。
units.en: You gather the three traditions of the Classic of Poetry from Hejian; you visit the nine masters along the Huai bend.
units.literal: He gathers the three traditions of the Classic of Poetry from Hejian; he visits the nine masters along the Huai bend.

units.zh: 術兼口傳之書，藝廣鏗鏘之樂。
units.en: Your arts embrace books passed mouth to mouth; your skills extend to ringing, resonant music.
units.literal: His arts embrace books passed mouth to mouth; his skills extend to ringing, resonant music.

units.zh: 時坐睡而梁懸，裁枝梧而錐握。
units.en: At times you dozed seated while a beam hung suspended; at times you trimmed branch-symbols while grasping an awl.
units.literal: At times he dozed seated while a beam hung suspended; at times he trimmed branch-symbols while grasping an awl.

units.zh: 旣文過而意深，又理勝而辭縟。
units.en: Your literary ornament exceeds yet your meaning is deep; your principle triumphs yet your diction is dense.
units.literal: His literary ornament exceeds yet his meaning is deep; his principle triumphs yet his diction is dense.

units.zh: 咨余生之荏苒，迫歲暮而傷情。
units.en: Ah, my remaining years pass swiftly; nearing year's end, my feelings are wounded.
units.literal: Ah, my remaining years pass swiftly; nearing year's end, my feelings are wounded.

units.zh: 測徂陰於堂下，聽鳴鐘於洛城。
units.en: I measure the declining yin beneath the hall; I listen to the ringing bells of Luoyang.
units.literal: I measure the declining yin beneath the hall; I listen to the ringing bells of Luoyang.

units.zh: 唯忘年之陸子，定一遇於班荊。
units.en: Only young-in-spirit Master Lu, fixing upon a single meeting among thorny plants.
units.literal: Only young-in-spirit Master Lu, fixing upon a single meeting among thorny plants.

units.zh: 余獲田蘇之價，爾得海上之名。
units.en: I gained the price of Tian Su; you gained a name beyond the sea.
units.literal: I gained the price of Tian Su; you gained a name beyond the sea.

units.zh: 信落魄而無產，終長對於短生。
units.en: Truly destitute without estate; in the end long facing short life.
units.literal: Truly destitute without estate; in the end long facing short life.

units.zh: 饑虛表于徐步，逃責顯於疾行。
units.en: Hunger showed plainly in slow steps; shirking blame showed clearly in hurried flight.
units.literal: Hunger showed plainly in slow steps; shirking blame showed clearly in hurried flight.

units.zh: 子比我於叔則，又方余於耀卿。
units.en: You compared me to Shuzi; you also likened me to Yao Qing.
units.literal: You compared me to Shuzi; you also likened me to Yao Qing.

units.zh: 心照情交，流言靡惑。
units.en: Our hearts illumined one another, our feelings exchanged; slander could not mislead us.
units.literal: Hearts illumined, feelings exchanged; slanderous words could not mislead.

units.zh: 萬類暗求，千里懸得。
units.en: Among ten thousand kinds we sought in darkness; across a thousand li we attained what hung before us.
units.literal: Among ten thousand kinds, sought in darkness; across a thousand li, attained as if suspended.

units.zh: 言象可廢，蹄筌自默。
units.en: Words and images may be discarded; hooves and fish-traps fall silent of themselves.
units.literal: Words and images may be discarded; hooves and fish-traps fall silent of themselves.

units.zh: 居非連棟，行則同車。
units.en: We did not dwell in linked pavilions, yet when we traveled we shared a carriage.
units.literal: We did not dwell in linked pavilions, yet when we traveled we shared a carriage.

units.zh: 冬日不足，夏日靡餘。
units.en: Winter days were never enough; summer days held no surplus.
units.literal: Winter days were never enough; summer days held no surplus.

units.zh: 肴核非餌，絲竹豈娛。
units.en: Meats and nuts were no bait; string and bamboo were no delight.
units.literal: Meats and nuts were no bait; string and bamboo were no delight.

units.zh: 我未舍駕，子已回輿。
units.en: I had not yet left my carriage when you already turned your cart about.
units.literal: I had not yet left my carriage when you already turned your cart about.

units.zh: 中飯相顧，悵然動色。
units.en: At midday meal we looked at each other, moved to desolation.
units.literal: At midday meal we looked at each other, moved to desolation.

units.zh: 邦壤旣殊，離會莫測。
units.en: Our lands were already different; parting and meeting could not be foretold.
units.literal: Our lands were already different; parting and meeting could not be foretold.

units.zh: 存異山陽之居，沒非要離之側。
units.en: Alive we dwelt apart like men of Shanyang; in death we would not demand to lie beside Yaoli.
units.literal: Alive we dwelt apart like men of Shanyang; in death we would not demand to lie beside Yaoli.

units.zh: 似膠投漆中，離婁豈能識。」
units.en: Like glue cast into lacquer—how could Li Lou discern it?"
units.literal: Like glue cast into lacquer—how could Li Lou discern it?"

units.zh: 其爲士友所重如此。
units.en: In such ways was he esteemed by men of letters.
units.literal: In such ways was he esteemed by men of affairs.

units.zh: 遷驃騎臨川王東曹掾。
units.en: He was promoted to eastern bureau aide on the staff of the Rapid Cavalry General, Prince of Linchuan.
units.literal: He was transferred to Eastern Bureau Aide under the Rapid Cavalry General, Prince of Linchuan.

units.zh: 是時禮樂制度，多所創革，高祖雅愛倕才，乃敕撰《新漏刻銘》，其文甚美。
units.en: At that time rites and music were being widely reformed; the emperor greatly valued Chui's talent and ordered him to compose the "Inscription on the New Clepsydra," a work of exceptional beauty.
units.literal: At that time rites and music institutions were largely created anew and reformed; the High Ancestor greatly cherished Chui's talent and ordered him to compose "Inscription on the New Clepsydra," the text of which was very fine.

units.zh: 遷太子中舍人，管東宮書記。
units.en: He was promoted to palace attendant of the heir apparent and oversaw the Eastern Palace records.
units.literal: He was transferred to Palace Attendant of the Heir Apparent and managed the Eastern Palace records.

units.zh: 又詔爲《石闕銘記》。
units.en: He was also ordered to compose the "Record-Inscription of the Stone Que."
units.literal: He was again ordered to compose "Record-Inscription of the Stone Que."

units.zh: 奏之。
units.en: He presented it to the throne.
units.literal: He presented it.

units.zh: 敕曰：「太子中舍人陸倕所制《石闕銘》，辭義典雅，足爲佳作。
units.en: An edict said: "The 'Inscription of the Stone Que' composed by Lu Chui, palace attendant of the heir apparent, is elegant in diction and meaning and fully qualifies as an excellent work.
units.literal: An edict said: "The 'Inscription of the Stone Que' composed by Lu Chui, Palace Attendant of the Heir Apparent, is elegant in diction and meaning and fully qualifies as an excellent work.

units.zh: 昔虞丘辨物，邯鄲獻賦，賞以金帛，前史美談，可賜絹三十匹。」
units.en: Formerly Yuqiu distinguished things and Handan presented a fu, and they were rewarded with gold and silk—a fine tale in former histories. Grant him thirty bolts of silk."
units.literal: Formerly Yuqiu distinguished things and Handan presented a fu, and they were rewarded with gold and silk—a fine tale in former histories. He may be granted thirty bolts of silk."

units.zh: 遷太子庶子、國子博士，母憂去職。
units.en: He was promoted to senior tutor of the heir apparent and erudite of the Imperial University, then left office to observe mourning for his mother.
units.literal: He was transferred to Senior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and Erudite of the Imperial University, then left office on account of his mother's mourning.

units.zh: 服闋，爲中書侍郎，給事黃門侍郎，揚州別駕從事史，以疾陳解。
units.en: When mourning ended he served as vice director of the Secretariat, attendant gentleman of the yellow gate, and aide to the Yangzhou administrator, then asked to resign on grounds of illness.
units.literal: When mourning ended he served as Vice Director of the Secretariat, Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, and Aide to the Yangzhou Administrator, then submitted a request to resign on grounds of illness.

units.zh: 遷鴻臚卿，入爲吏部郎，參選事。
units.en: He was promoted to grand master of ceremonies, then entered the capital as director of the Ministry of Personnel and took part in official selection.
units.literal: He was transferred to Grand Master of Ceremonies, entered the capital as Director of the Ministry of Personnel, and participated in selection affairs.

units.zh: 出爲雲麾晉安王長史、尋陽太守、行江州府州事。
units.en: He left the capital as chief clerk to the Cloud-Banner General, Prince of Jin'an, as administrator of Xunyang and acting overseer of Jiangzhou affairs.
units.literal: He went out as Chief Clerk to the Cloud-Banner General, Prince of Jin'an, Administrator of Xunyang, and acting overseer of Jiangzhou prefectural affairs.

units.zh: 以公事免，左遷中書侍郎、司徒司馬、太子中庶子、廷尉卿。
units.en: Dismissed over an official matter, he was demoted to Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat, Marshal for the Minister over the Masses, Junior Mentor in the heir apparent's household, and Chamberlain for Law Enforcement.
units.literal: Dismissed over an official matter, he was demoted to Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat, Marshal for the Minister over the Masses, Junior Mentor in the heir apparent's household, and Chamberlain for Law Enforcement.

units.zh: 又爲中庶子，加給事中、揚州大中正。
units.en: He again served as junior tutor, with additional appointment as supervising attendant and senior rectifier of Yangzhou.
units.literal: He again served as Junior Tutor, with additional appointment as Supervising Attendant and Senior Rectifier of Yangzhou.

units.zh: 復除國子博士、中庶子、中正並如故。
units.en: He was again appointed erudite of the Imperial University, junior tutor, and rectifier, all as before.
units.literal: He was again appointed Erudite of the Imperial University, Junior Tutor, and Rectifier, all as before.

units.zh: 守太常卿，中正如故。
units.en: He served as acting minister of ceremonies, retaining his rectifier duties as before.
units.literal: He served as Acting Minister of Ceremonies, with rectifier duties as before.

units.zh: 普通七年，卒，年五十七。
units.en: In the seventh year of Putong he died at the age of fifty-seven.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Putong he died, aged fifty-seven.

units.zh: 文集二十卷，行於世。
units.en: His collected writings in twenty fascicles circulated in his day.
units.literal: His collected writings in twenty juan circulated in the world.

units.zh: 第四子纘，早慧，十歲通經，爲童子奉車郎，卒。
units.en: His fourth son Zuan was precocious; at ten he had mastered the classics, served as palace groom for youthful scholars, and died young.
units.literal: His fourth son Zuan was precocious early; at ten he mastered the classics, served as Palace Groom for Youthful Scholars, and died.

units.zh: 到洽字茂㳂，彭城武原人也。
units.en: Dao Qia, styled Maoheng, came from Wuyuan in Pengcheng commandery.
units.literal: Dao Qia, styled Maoheng, was a man of Wuyuan in Pengcheng.

units.zh: 宋驃騎將軍彥之曾孫。
units.en: He was a great-grandson of Yanzhi, who had served Song as Rapid Cavalry General.
units.literal: He was the great-grandson of Yanzhi, Rapid Cavalry General of Song.

units.zh: 祖仲度，驃騎江夏王從事中郎。
units.en: His grandfather Zhongdu had been aide-de-camp to the Rapid Cavalry General, Prince of Jiangxia.
units.literal: His grandfather Zhongdu was Aide-de-Camp to the Rapid Cavalry General, Prince of Jiangxia.

units.zh: 父坦，齊中書郎。
units.en: His father Tan had served Qi as director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: His father Tan was Director of the Secretariat of Qi.

units.zh: 洽年十八，爲南徐州迎西曹行事。
units.en: At eighteen Qia served as acting western bureau clerk in the welcome office of Southern Xuzhou.
units.literal: At eighteen Qia served as Acting Western Bureau Clerk for the Welcome Office of Southern Xuzhou.

units.zh: 洽少知名，清警有才學士行。
units.en: From youth Qia was well known—clear-minded, sharp, and accomplished in learning and conduct.
units.literal: Qia from youth was known by reputation, clear and alert in talent, learning, conduct, and integrity.

units.zh: 謝朓文章盛於一時，見洽深相賞好，日引與談論。
units.en: Xie Tiao's writing was the finest of his age; on meeting Qia he took a deep liking to him and drew him into conversation every day.
units.literal: Xie Tiao's literary compositions flourished in his age; seeing Qia, he deeply admired and favored him and daily drew him into discussion.

units.zh: 每謂洽曰：「君非直名人，乃亦兼資文武。」
units.en: He often told Qia, "You are not merely a man of reputation—you combine civil and military gifts as well."
units.literal: He often told Qia, "You are not merely a man of reputation; you also combine civil and military gifts."

units.zh: 朓後爲吏部，洽去職，朓欲薦之，洽睹世方亂，深相拒絕。
units.en: Later, when Tiao became director of the Ministry of Personnel, Qia had left office; Tiao wished to recommend him, but Qia, seeing the realm turning chaotic, firmly refused.
units.literal: Later, when Tiao became Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Qia left office; Tiao wished to recommend him, but Qia, seeing the age turning chaotic, firmly refused.

units.zh: 除晉安王國左常侍，不就。
units.en: He was appointed left regular attendant in the principality of Jin'an but declined the post.
units.literal: He was appointed Left Regular Attendant of the Principality of Jin'an but did not accept.

units.zh: 遂築室巖阿，幽居者積歲。
units.en: He then built a house in a mountain hollow and lived in seclusion for many years.
units.literal: He then built a dwelling in a mountain recess and lived in seclusion for many years.

units.zh: 樂安任昉有知人之鑒，與洽兄沼、溉並善。
units.en: Ren Fang of Le'an had a discerning eye for talent and was close friends with Qia's elder brothers Zhao and Gai.
units.literal: Ren Fang of Le'an had a discerning eye for men and was on good terms with Qia's elder brothers Zhao and Gai.

units.zh: 嘗訪洽於田舍，見之歎曰：「此子日下無雙。」
units.en: Once he visited Qia at his farmstead and, on seeing him, exclaimed, "This youth has no peer under the sun."
units.literal: Once he visited Qia at his farmstead and, on seeing him, sighed and said, "This youth has no peer under the sun."

units.zh: 遂申拜親之禮。
units.en: He then treated him with the ceremony due a close friend.
units.literal: He then extended the ceremony of acknowledging him as a close friend.

units.zh: 天監初，沼、溉俱蒙擢用，洽尤見知賞，從弟沆亦相與齊名。
units.en: Early in the Tianjian era Zhao and Gai were both promoted; Qia was especially favored, and his cousin Hang was equally renowned.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianjian Zhao and Gai were both promoted and employed; Qia was especially known and rewarded, and his younger cousin of the same clan Hang was likewise famed in equal measure.

units.zh: 高祖問待詔丘遲曰：「到洽何如沆、溉？」
units.en: The emperor asked the attendant-in-waiting Qiu Chi, "How does Dao Qia compare with Hang and Gai?"
units.literal: The High Ancestor asked the Attendant-in-Waiting Qiu Chi, "How does Dao Qia compare with Hang and Gai?"

units.zh: 遲對曰：「正清過於沆，文章不減溉；
units.en: Chi replied, "In upright clarity he surpasses Hang; in literary composition he is no less than Gai;
units.literal: Chi replied, "In upright clarity he surpasses Hang; in literary composition he does not fall short of Gai;

units.zh: 加以清言，殆將難及。」
units.en: and with pure talk added, he will perhaps be hard to match."
units.literal: and with pure talk added, he will perhaps be hard to match."

units.zh: 卽召爲太子舍人。
units.en: He was immediately summoned as attendant of the heir apparent.
units.literal: He was immediately summoned as Attendant of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 御華光殿，詔洽及沆、蕭琛、任昉侍讌，賦二十韻詩，以洽辭爲工，賜絹二十匹。
units.en: At Huaguang Hall the emperor ordered Qia, Hang, Xiao Chen, and Ren Fang to attend a banquet; composing twenty-rhyme poems, the court judged Qia's diction the finest and granted him twenty bolts of silk.
units.literal: At Huaguang Hall the emperor ordered Qia, Hang, Xiao Chen, and Ren Fang to attend the banquet; composing poems of twenty rhymes, Qia's diction was judged the most accomplished, and he was granted twenty bolts of silk.

units.zh: 高祖謂昉曰：「諸到可謂才子。」
units.en: The emperor said to Fang, "The various Daos may truly be called men of talent."
units.literal: The High Ancestor said to Fang, "The various Daos may be called men of talent."

units.zh: 昉對曰：「臣常竊議，宋得其武，梁得其文。」
units.en: Fang replied, "Your servant has often privately remarked that Song obtained their martial men, while Liang obtains their literary men."
units.literal: Fang replied, "Your servant has often privately remarked that Song obtained their martial men, while Liang obtains their literary men."

units.zh: 二年，遷司徒主簿，直待詔省，敕使抄甲部書。
units.en: In the second year he was promoted to chief clerk of the Secretariat, served in the attendant-in-waiting office, and was ordered to copy books of the first category.
units.literal: In the second year he was transferred to Chief Clerk of the Secretariat, served directly in the Attendant-in-Waiting Office, and was ordered to copy books of the first category.

units.zh: 五年，遷尚書殿中郎。
units.en: In the fifth year he was promoted to palace attendant in the Ministry of State Affairs.
units.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Palace Attendant of the Ministry of State Affairs.

units.zh: 洽兄弟羣從，遞居此職，時人榮之。
units.en: Qia's brothers and cousins held this post in succession, to the envy of their contemporaries.
units.literal: Qia's brothers and clan cousins in succession held this post, and men of the time regarded it as an honor.

units.zh: 七年，遷太子中舍人，與庶子陸倕對掌東宮管記。
units.en: In the seventh year he was promoted to palace attendant of the heir apparent and, with junior tutor Lu Chui, jointly managed the Eastern Palace records.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Palace Attendant of the Heir Apparent and, with Junior Tutor Lu Chui, jointly managed the Eastern Palace records.

units.zh: 俄爲侍讀，侍讀省仍置學士二人，洽復充其選。
units.en: Soon he became lecturer-in-attendance; the lecturer's office still appointed two scholars, and Qia again filled one of those posts.
units.literal: Soon he became Lecturer-in-Attendance; the Lecturer-in-Attendance Office still appointed two scholars, and Qia again filled that selection.

units.zh: 九年，遷國子博士，奉敕撰《太學碑》。
units.en: In the ninth year he was promoted to erudite of the Imperial University and received an imperial order to compose the "Stele of the Imperial Academy."
units.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to Erudite of the Imperial University and received an order to compose "Stele of the Imperial Academy."

units.zh: 十二年，出爲臨川內史，在郡稱職。
units.en: In the twelfth year he left the capital as internal administrator of Linchuan and earned a reputation for competent governance.
units.literal: In the twelfth year he went out as Internal Administrator of Linchuan and in the commandery was regarded as fulfilling his duties.

units.zh: 十四年，入爲太子家令，遷給事黃門侍郎，兼國子博士。
units.en: In the fourteenth year he entered the capital as steward of the heir apparent's household, was promoted to attendant gentleman of the yellow gate, and concurrently served as erudite of the Imperial University.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year he entered the capital as Steward of the Heir Apparent's Household, was transferred to Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, and concurrently served as Erudite of the Imperial University.

units.zh: 十六年，行太子中庶子。
units.en: In the sixteenth year he served as acting junior tutor of the heir apparent.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year he served as Acting Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 普通元年，以本官領博士。
units.en: In the first year of Putong he retained his post while additionally serving as erudite.
units.literal: In the first year of Putong he held his existing office while additionally serving as Erudite.

units.zh: 頃之，入爲尚書吏部郎，請託一無所行。
units.en: Soon he entered the capital as director of the Ministry of Personnel in the Secretariat and refused every request for favor.
units.literal: Shortly thereafter he entered the capital as Director of the Ministry of Personnel in the Secretariat; not a single request for favor was granted.

units.zh: 俄遷員外散騎常侍，復領博士，母憂去職。
units.en: Soon he was promoted to supernumerary regular attendant of the scattered cavalry and again held the erudite post, then left office to mourn his mother.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to Supernumerary Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry and again held the erudite post, then left office on account of his mother's mourning.

units.zh: 五年，復爲太子中庶子，領步兵校尉，未拜，仍遷給事黃門侍郎，領尚書左丞。
units.en: In the fifth year he again became Junior Mentor in the heir apparent's household and was to serve concurrently as Commandant of Foot Soldiers; before he could assume that post, he was promoted to Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate and concurrently Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: In the fifth year he again became Junior Mentor in the heir apparent's household and concurrently Commandant of Foot Soldiers; before he could take up the post, he was transferred to Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate and concurrently Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 準繩不避貴戚，尚書省賄賂莫敢通。
units.en: He applied standards without sparing noble kin, and within the Secretariat no one dared offer bribes.
units.literal: In applying standards he did not spare noble kin; within the Secretariat no one dared to offer bribes.

units.zh: 時鑾輿欲親戎，軍國容禮，多自洽出。
units.en: At that time the emperor was about to take the field in person, and military and state ceremonial matters largely issued from Qia.
units.literal: At that time the imperial carriage was about to take the field in person; military and state ceremonial matters largely issued from Qia.

units.zh: 六年，遷御史中丞，彈糾無所顧望，號爲勁直，當時肅清。
units.en: In the sixth year he was promoted to palace censor-in-chief; in impeachment and correction he showed no regard for favor, was styled stern and upright, and the court was thereby purified.
units.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to Palace Censor-in-Chief; in impeachment and correction he showed no regard for favor, was styled stern and upright, and the age was thereby purified.

units.zh: 以公事左降，猶居職。
units.en: Demoted on account of a public matter, he nevertheless retained his post.
units.literal: On account of public business he was demoted to the left but still held office.

units.zh: 舊制，中丞不得入尚書下舍，洽兄溉爲左民尚書，洽引服親不應有礙，刺省詳決。
units.en: By old regulation the censor-in-chief might not enter the lower quarters of the Secretariat; Qia's elder brother Gai was director of the left for the people in the Secretariat, and Qia cited mourning garb and close kinship as grounds that there should be no impediment, submitting a memorial for detailed decision.
units.literal: By old regulation the Censor-in-Chief might not enter the lower quarters of the Secretariat; Qia's elder brother Gai was Director of the Left for the People in the Secretariat, and Qia cited mourning garb and close kinship as grounds that there should be no impediment, submitting a memorial for detailed decision by the Secretariat.

units.zh: 左丞蕭子雲議許入溉省，亦以其兄弟素篤，不能相別也。
units.en: Left director Xiao Ziyun proposed permitting entry into Gai's office, likewise on the grounds that the brothers had long been deeply devoted and could not be set apart.
units.literal: Left Director Xiao Ziyun proposed permitting entry into Gai's office, likewise on the grounds that the brothers had long been deeply devoted and could not be set apart.

units.zh: 七年，出爲貞威將軍、雲麾長史、尋陽太守。
units.en: In the seventh year he left the capital as general of upright prestige, chief clerk of the cloud-banner army, and administrator of Xunyang.
units.literal: In the seventh year he went out as General of Upright Prestige, Chief Clerk of the Cloud-Banner Army, and Administrator of Xunyang.

units.zh: 大通元年，卒於郡，時年五十一。
units.en: In the first year of Datong he died in office at the age of fifty-one.
units.literal: In the first year of Datong he died in the commandery, aged fifty-one.

units.zh: 贈侍中。
units.en: He was posthumously appointed attendant-in-chief.
units.literal: He was posthumously appointed Attendant-in-Chief.

units.zh: 諡曰理子。
units.en: His posthumous title was Lizi, "The Principled."
units.literal: His posthumous title was Lizi.

units.zh: 昭明太子與晉安王綱令曰：「明北兗、到長史遂相系凋落，傷怛悲惋，不能已已。
units.en: Crown Prince Zhaoming sent a letter to Prince Jing'an, Xiao Gang, saying, "Ming of Northern Yanzhou and Chief Clerk Dao have died in succession; my grief and sorrow cannot be stilled.
units.literal: Crown Prince Zhaoming sent a letter to Prince Jing'an, Xiao Gang, saying, "Ming of Northern Yanzhou and Chief Clerk Dao have in succession withered and fallen; my grief and sorrow cannot be stilled.

units.zh: 去歲陸太常殂歿，今茲二賢長謝。
units.en: Last year Minister of Ceremonies Lu passed away; this year these two worthies have departed as well.
units.literal: Last year Minister of Ceremonies Lu passed away; this year these two worthies have long departed.

units.zh: 陸生資忠履貞，冰清玉潔，文該四始，學遍九流，高情勝氣，貞然直上。
units.en: Master Lu was endowed with loyalty and practiced purity, clear as ice and clean as jade; his writing encompassed the four beginnings of the Classic of Poetry, his learning pervaded the nine schools; lofty in feeling and surpassing in spirit, he stood upright and ascended.
units.literal: Master Lu was endowed with loyalty and practiced purity, clear as ice and clean as jade; his writing encompassed the four beginnings, his learning pervaded the nine schools; lofty in feeling and surpassing in spirit, he stood upright and ascended.

units.zh: 明公儒學稽古，淳厚篤誠，立身行道，始終如一，儻值夫子，必升孔堂。
units.en: Lord Ming was learned in the Confucian classics and versed in antiquity. He was honest, generous, and deeply sincere; in establishing himself and practicing the Way, he remained consistent from beginning to end. Had he lived in the Master's time, he would surely have entered Confucius's hall.
units.literal: Lord Ming studied Confucian learning and investigated antiquity, pure, thick, and sincerely devoted; in establishing himself and practicing the Way he was one from beginning to end—had he met the Master, he would surely have ascended the Hall of Confucius.

units.zh: 到子風神開爽，文義可觀，當官蒞事，介然無私。
units.en: Master Dao was open and bright in spirit and bearing, and his writings and arguments were admirable. When he held office and managed affairs, he was firm and without selfishness.
units.literal: Master Dao was open and bright in spirit and bearing; his literary meaning was admirable; in holding office and attending to affairs he was detached and without private interest.

units.zh: 皆海內之俊乂，東序之秘寶。
units.en: Both were outstanding men within the realm and secret treasures of the Eastern Palace.
units.literal: Both were outstanding men within the seas and secret treasures of the Eastern Palace.

units.zh: 此之嗟惜，更復何論。
units.en: To lament and cherish them thus—what more is there to say?
units.literal: To lament and cherish them thus—what more is there to say?

units.zh: 但遊處周旋，並淹歲序，造膝忠規，豈可勝說，倖免祇悔，實二三子之力也。
units.en: Yet in roaming and associating we passed many years together; loyal admonitions spoken knee to knee—how could they be told in full? That I escaped shame and repentance was truly the work of these two or three men.
units.literal: Yet in roaming and associating and in mutual dealings we passed many years together; loyal admonitions spoken knee to knee—how could they be told in full? That I escaped shame and repentance was truly the work of these two or three men.

units.zh: 談對如昨，音言在耳，零落相仍，皆成異物，每一念至，何時可言。
units.en: Conversation face to face was like yesterday; their voices still ring in my ear—yet one after another they have fallen away and all have become strange things; each time the thought comes, when may it be spoken?
units.literal: Conversation face to face was like yesterday; their voices still ring in the ear—yet one after another they have fallen away and all have become strange things; each time the thought comes, when may it be spoken?

units.zh: 天下之寶，理當惻愴。
units.en: Treasures of the realm—by right one should be deeply sorrowful.
units.literal: Treasures of the realm—by right one should be deeply sorrowful.

units.zh: 近張新安又致故，其人文筆弘雅，亦足嗟惜，隨弟府朝，東西日久，尤當傷懷也。
units.en: Recently Zhang of Xin'an has also passed away; his writing was grand and elegant, likewise worthy of lament. With my younger brother at court in the princely establishment, east and west separated for long days—this especially wounds the heart.
units.literal: Recently Zhang of Xin'an has also passed away; his literary brush was grand and elegant, likewise worthy of lament. With my younger brother at court in the princely establishment, east and west separated for long days—this especially should wound the heart.

units.zh: 比人物零落，特可傷惋，屬有今信，乃復及之。」
units.en: Lately men have fallen away one after another, especially worthy of grief and regret; as there is this present letter, I touch upon it again."
units.literal: Lately men have fallen away one after another, especially worthy of grief and regret; as there is this present letter, I again touch upon it."

units.zh: 洽文集行於世。
units.en: Qia's collected writings circulated in his day.
units.literal: Qia's collected writings circulated in the world.

units.zh: 子伯淮、仲舉。
units.en: His sons were Bohuai and Zhongju.
units.literal: His sons were Bohuai and Zhongju.

units.zh: 明山賓字孝若，平原鬲人也。
units.en: Ming Shanbin, styled Xiaoruo, came from Ge in Pingyuan commandery.
units.literal: Ming Shanbin, styled Xiaoruo, was a man of Ge in Pingyuan.

units.zh: 父僧紹，隱居不仕，宋末國子博士徵，不就。
units.en: His father Sengshao lived in seclusion and did not take office; at the end of Song he was summoned as erudite of the Imperial University but declined.
units.literal: His father Sengshao lived in seclusion and did not take office; at the end of Song he was summoned as Erudite of the Imperial University but did not accept.

units.zh: 山賓七歲能言名理，十三博通經傳，居喪盡禮。
units.en: At seven Shanbin could discourse on principles of names; at thirteen he had broadly mastered the classics and their commentaries; in mourning he fulfilled every rite.
units.literal: At seven Shanbin could discourse on principles of names; at thirteen he broadly mastered the classics and their commentaries; in mourning he fulfilled every rite.

units.zh: 服闋，州辟從事史。
units.en: When mourning ended the province summoned him as aide.
units.literal: When mourning ended the province summoned him as Aide.

units.zh: 起家奉朝請。
units.en: He began his career as court gentleman for imperial audience.
units.literal: He began his career as Court Gentleman for Imperial Audience.

units.zh: 兄仲璋嬰痼疾，家道屢空，山賓乃行干祿。
units.en: His elder brother Zhongzhang suffered a chronic illness; the household was repeatedly impoverished, and Shanbin then sought salary by office.
units.literal: His elder brother Zhongzhang suffered a chronic illness; the household was repeatedly empty, and Shanbin then sought salary by office.

units.zh: 齊始安王蕭遙光引爲撫軍行參軍，後爲廣陽令，頃之去官。
units.en: The Prince of Shi'an of Qi, Xiao Yaoguang, brought him in as acting aide of the pacifying army; later he served as magistrate of Guangyang, and shortly left office.
units.literal: The Prince of Shi'an of Qi, Xiao Yaoguang, brought him in as Acting Aide of the Pacifying Army; later he served as Magistrate of Guangyang, and shortly left office.

units.zh: 義師至，高祖引爲相府田曹參軍。
units.en: When the army of righteousness arrived, Emperor Wu brought him in as aide in the Fields Bureau of the Chancellor's Office.
units.literal: When the army of righteousness arrived, the High Ancestor brought him in as Aide in the Fields Bureau of the Chancellor's Office.

units.zh: 梁臺建，爲尚書駕部郎，遷治書侍御史，右軍記室參軍，掌治吉禮。
units.en: When the Liang regime was established he served as director of the carriage section in the Secretariat, was promoted to attending censor, recorder of the right army, and oversaw auspicious rites.
units.literal: When the Liang regime was established he served as Director of the Carriage Section in the Secretariat, was transferred to Attending Censor, Recorder of the Right Army, and oversaw auspicious rites.

units.zh: 時初置《五經》博士，山賓首膺其選。
units.en: At that time the Five Classics erudites were first established, and Shanbin was the first chosen.
units.literal: At that time the Five Classics erudites were first established, and Shanbin was the first chosen.

units.zh: 遷北中郎諮議參軍，侍皇太子讀。
units.en: He was promoted to advisory aide of the north central commandant and attended the heir apparent in study.
units.literal: He was transferred to Advisory Aide of the North Central Commandant and attended the Heir Apparent in study.

units.zh: 累遷中書侍郎、國子博士、太子率更令、中庶子，博士如故。
units.en: He rose through vice director of the Secretariat, erudite of the Imperial University, commandant of the heir apparent's rate regulation, and junior tutor, retaining his erudite duties as before.
units.literal: He was repeatedly transferred to Vice Director of the Secretariat, Erudite of the Imperial University, Commandant of the Heir Apparent's Rate Regulation, and Junior Tutor, with erudite duties as before.

units.zh: 天監十五年，出爲持節、督緣淮諸軍事、征遠將軍、北兗州刺史。
units.en: In the fifteenth year of Tianjian he left the capital bearing the staff of authority as supervisor of military affairs along the Huai and as general who subdues the distance and inspector of Northern Yanzhou.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year of Tianjian he went out bearing the staff of authority as Supervisor of Military Affairs along the Huai and as General Who Subdues the Distance and Inspector of Northern Yanzhou.

units.zh: 普通二年，徵爲太子右衛率，加給事中，遷御史中丞。
units.en: In the second year of Putong he was summoned as right commandant of the heir apparent's guard, with additional appointment as supervising attendant, and promoted to palace censor-in-chief.
units.literal: In the second year of Putong he was summoned as Right Commandant of the Heir Apparent's Guard, with additional appointment as Supervising Attendant, and transferred to Palace Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 以公事左遷黃門侍郎、司農卿。
units.en: Demoted on account of a public matter, he became attendant of the yellow gate and minister of agriculture.
units.literal: On account of public business he was demoted to the left as Attendant of the Yellow Gate and Minister of Agriculture.

units.zh: 四年，遷散騎常侍，領青冀二州大中正。
units.en: In the fourth year he was promoted to regular attendant of the scattered cavalry and concurrently senior rectifier of Qing and Ji provinces.
units.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry and concurrently Senior Rectifier of Qing and Ji provinces.

units.zh: 東宮新置學士，又以山賓居之，俄以本官兼國子祭酒。
units.en: The Eastern Palace newly appointed scholars, and Shanbin again held that post; soon, in his existing office, he concurrently served as libationer of the Imperial University.
units.literal: The Eastern Palace newly appointed scholars, and Shanbin again held that post; soon, in his existing office, he concurrently served as Libationer of the Imperial University.

units.zh: 初，山賓在州，所部平陸縣不稔，啓出倉米以贍人。
units.en: Earlier, when Shanbin was in the province, Pinglu county in his jurisdiction had a poor harvest; he memorialized to release granary grain to support the people.
units.literal: Earlier, when Shanbin was in the province, Pinglu county in his jurisdiction had a poor harvest; he memorialized to release granary grain to support the people.

units.zh: 後刺史檢州曹，失簿書，以山賓爲耗闕，有司追責，籍其宅入官，山賓默不自理，更市地造宅。
units.en: Later the inspector examined the provincial offices and lost the account books; Shanbin was held responsible for the shortfall, the authorities pursued him for liability, and his residence was registered and taken into state ownership. Shanbin made no defense on his own behalf and instead bought land elsewhere to build a house.
units.literal: Later the inspector examined the provincial offices and lost the account books; Shanbin was held responsible for the shortfall, the authorities pursued him for liability, and his residence was registered and taken into state ownership. Shanbin silently made no defense on his own behalf and instead bought land elsewhere to build a house.

units.zh: 昭明太子聞築室不就，有令曰：「明祭酒雖出撫大籓，擁旄推轂，珥金拖紫，而恒事屢空。
units.en: Crown Prince Zhaoming heard that construction of the house was not completed and issued an order: "Libationer Ming, though he went out to govern a great frontier, bearing banners and pushing the chariot wheel, wearing gold at the ear and trailing purple, yet his household was repeatedly empty.
units.literal: Crown Prince Zhaoming heard that construction of the house was not completed and issued an order: "Libationer Ming, though he went out to govern a great frontier, bearing banners and pushing the chariot wheel, wearing gold at the ear and trailing purple, yet his constant affairs were repeatedly empty.

units.zh: 聞構宇未成，今送薄助。」
units.en: Hearing that the building is not yet finished, I now send modest assistance."
units.literal: Hearing that the building is not yet finished, I now send modest assistance."

units.zh: 並貽詩曰：「平仲古稱奇，夷吾昔檀美。
units.en: He also sent a poem: "Ping Zhong was called marvelous in antiquity; Yi Wu was once praised as excellent.
units.literal: He also sent a poem: "Ping Zhong was called marvelous in antiquity; Yi Wu was once praised as excellent.

units.zh: 令則挺伊賢，東秦固多士。
units.en: Your command district then produced worthy men of Yi; eastern Qin indeed had many scholars.
units.literal: Your command district then produced worthy men of Yi; eastern Qin indeed had many scholars.

units.zh: 築室非道傍，置宅歸仁里。
units.en: Build your house not beside the road; set your residence in the hamlet of Return to Benevolence.
units.literal: Build your house not beside the road; set your residence in the hamlet of Return to Benevolence.

units.zh: 庚桑方有係，原生今易擬。
units.en: Gengsang had just gained a tie; Yuansheng today may easily be compared.
units.literal: Gengsang had just gained a tie; Yuansheng today may easily be compared.

units.zh: 必來三徑人，將招《五經》士。」
units.en: Surely men of the three paths will come; you will summon scholars of the Five Classics."
units.literal: Surely men of the three paths will come; you will summon scholars of the Five Classics."

units.zh: 山賓性篤實，家中嘗乏用，貨所乘牛。
units.en: Shanbin's nature was sincere and solid; at home he was often short of supplies and sold the ox he rode.
units.literal: Shanbin's nature was sincere and solid; at home he was often short of supplies and sold the ox he rode.

units.zh: 旣售受錢，乃謂買主曰：「此牛經患漏蹄，治差已久，恐後脫髮，無容不相語。」
units.en: After the sale he received the money and then told the buyer, "This ox once suffered from cracked hooves; it has been cured for some time, but I fear the hooves may later shed—I could not fail to tell you."
units.literal: After the sale he received the money and then told the buyer, "This ox once suffered from cracked hooves; it has been cured for some time, but I fear the hooves may later shed—I could not fail to tell you."

units.zh: 買主遽追取錢。
units.en: The buyer immediately pursued him to take back the money.
units.literal: The buyer immediately pursued him to take back the money.

units.zh: 處士阮孝緒聞之，歎曰：「此言足使還淳反朴，激薄停澆矣。」
units.en: The recluse Ruan Xiaoxu heard of it and sighed, "These words are enough to return purity and simplicity, to stir the thin and halt the dissolute."
units.literal: The Recluse Ruan Xiaoxu heard of it and sighed, "These words are enough to return purity and simplicity, to stir the thin and halt the dissolute."

units.zh: 五年，又爲國子博士，常侍、中正如故。
units.en: In the fifth year he again became erudite of the Imperial University, with regular attendant and rectifier duties as before.
units.literal: In the fifth year he again became Erudite of the Imperial University, with regular attendant and rectifier duties as before.

units.zh: 其年以本官假節，權攝北兗州事。
units.en: That same year, in his existing office he received temporary credentials and acted as overseer of Northern Yanzhou affairs.
units.literal: That same year, in his existing office he received temporary credentials and acted as overseer of Northern Yanzhou affairs.

units.zh: 大通元年，卒，時年八十五。
units.en: In the first year of Datong he died at the age of eighty-five.
units.literal: In the first year of Datong he died, aged eighty-five.

units.zh: 詔贈侍中、信威將軍。
units.en: An edict posthumously appointed him attendant-in-chief and general of trustworthy prestige.
units.literal: An edict posthumously appointed him Attendant-in-Chief and General of Trustworthy Prestige.

units.zh: 諡曰質子。
units.en: His posthumous title was Zhizi, "The Sincere."
units.literal: His posthumous title was Zhizi.

units.zh: 昭明太子爲舉哀，賻錢十萬，布百匹，並使舍人王顒監護喪事。
units.en: Crown Prince Zhaoming performed mourning rites for him, sent funeral gifts of one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth, and dispatched attendant Wang Yan to oversee the funeral affairs.
units.literal: Crown Prince Zhaoming performed mourning rites for him, sent funeral gifts of one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth, and dispatched Attendant Wang Yan to oversee the funeral affairs.

units.zh: 又與前司徒左長史殷芸令曰：「北兗信至，明常侍遂至殞逝，聞之傷怛。
units.en: He also sent a letter to the former left chief clerk of the Secretariat, Yin Yun, saying, "Word has come from Northern Yanzhou; attendant-in-ordinary Ming has now passed away—hearing it wounds me deeply.
units.literal: He also sent a letter to the former Left Chief Clerk of the Secretariat, Yin Yun, saying, "Word has come from Northern Yanzhou; Attendant-in-Ordinary Ming has now passed away—hearing it wounds me deeply.

units.zh: 此賢儒術該通，志用稽古，溫厚淳和，倫雅弘篤。
units.en: This worthy man's Confucian learning was comprehensive and penetrating; his will and application investigated antiquity; he was warm, thick, pure, and harmonious, elegant in conduct and broadly sincere.
units.literal: This worthy man's Confucian learning was comprehensive and penetrating; his will and application investigated antiquity; he was warm, thick, pure, and harmonious, elegant in conduct and broadly sincere.

units.zh: 授經以來，迄今二紀。
units.en: From the time he lectured on the classics until now has been twenty-four years.
units.literal: From the time he lectured on the classics until now has been two twelve-year cycles.

units.zh: 若其上交不諂，造膝忠規，非顯外迹，得之胸懷者，蓋亦積矣。
units.en: As for his dealings with superiors without flattery, loyal admonitions spoken knee to knee—not outward traces made visible but gained from the heart—there was also much accumulated.
units.literal: As for his dealings with superiors without flattery, loyal admonitions spoken knee to knee—not outward traces made visible but gained from the breast—there was also much accumulated.

units.zh: 攝官連率，行當言歸，不謂長往，眇成疇日。
units.en: He held office as acting overseer of the commandery and was about to speak of returning; I did not expect a long departure, yet in a blink it became days past.
units.literal: He held office as acting overseer of the commandery and was about to speak of returning; I did not expect a long departure, yet in a blink it became days past.

units.zh: 追憶談緒，皆爲悲端，往矣如何！
units.en: Recalling our talks, all become beginnings of grief—he is gone, alas!
units.literal: Recalling our talks, all become beginnings of grief—he is gone, alas!

units.zh: 昔經聯事，理當酸愴也。」
units.en: Formerly we were joined in office—by right one should be bitterly sorrowful."
units.literal: Formerly we were joined in office—by right one should be bitterly sorrowful."

units.zh: 山賓累居學官，甚有訓導之益，然性頗疏通，接於諸生，多所狎比，人皆愛之。
units.en: Shanbin repeatedly held academic offices and was greatly beneficial in instruction and guidance, yet his nature was rather open and easy; in dealing with students he was much given to familiar intimacy, and all loved him.
units.literal: Shanbin repeatedly held academic offices and was greatly beneficial in instruction and guidance, yet his nature was rather open and easy; in dealing with students he was much given to familiar intimacy, and all loved him.

units.zh: 所著《吉禮儀注》二百二十四卷，《禮儀》二十卷，《孝經喪禮服義》十五卷。
units.en: His works included Annotated Auspicious Rites in 224 fascicles, Rites in 20 fascicles, and Exegesis on Mourning Garments for the Classic of Filial Piety in 15 fascicles.
units.literal: His works included Annotated Auspicious Rites in 224 juan, Rites in 20 juan, and Exegesis on Mourning Garments for the Classic of Filial Piety in 15 juan.

units.zh: 子震，字興道，亦傳父業。
units.en: His son Zhen, styled Xingdao, also inherited his father's profession.
units.literal: His son Zhen, styled Xingdao, also inherited his father's profession.

units.zh: 歷官太學博士，太子舍人，尚書祠部郎，餘姚令。
units.en: He held office as erudite of the Imperial Academy, attendant of the heir apparent, director of the sacrificial section in the Secretariat, and magistrate of Yuyao.
units.literal: He held office as Erudite of the Imperial Academy, Attendant of the Heir Apparent, Director of the Sacrificial Section in the Secretariat, and Magistrate of Yuyao.

units.zh: 殷鈞字季和，陳郡長平人也。
units.en: Yin Jun, styled Jihe, came from Changping in Chen commandery.
units.literal: Yin Jun, styled Jihe, was a man of Changping in Chen commandery.

units.zh: 晉太常融八世孫。
units.en: He was an eighth-generation descendant of Yin Rong, who had served Jin as Minister of Ceremonies.
units.literal: He was the eighth-generation descendant of Rong, Minister of Ceremonies of Jin.

units.zh: 父叡，有才辯，知名齊世，歷官司徒從事中郎。
units.en: His father Rui had talent in debate and was renowned in the Qi age, holding office as aide-de-camp to the minister of works.
units.literal: His father Rui had talent in debate and was renowned in the Qi age, holding office as Aide-de-Camp to the Minister of Works.

units.zh: 叡妻王奐女。
units.en: Rui's wife was a daughter of Wang Huan.
units.literal: Rui's wife was a daughter of Wang Huan.

units.zh: 奐爲雍州刺史、鎮北將軍，乃言於朝，以叡爲鎮北長史、河南太守。
units.en: Huan was inspector of Yong Province and general who pacifies the north; he spoke to the court and had Rui appointed chief clerk of the pacifying north and administrator of Henan.
units.literal: Huan was Inspector of Yong Province and General Who Pacifies the North; he spoke to the court and had Rui appointed Chief Clerk of the Pacifying North and Administrator of Henan.

units.zh: 奐誅，叡並見害。
units.en: When Huan was executed, Rui was also killed.
units.literal: When Huan was executed, Rui was also killed.

units.zh: 鈞時年九歲，以孝聞。
units.en: Jun was then nine years old and became known for filial piety.
units.literal: Jun was then nine years old and became known for filial piety.

units.zh: 及長，恬靜簡交遊，好學有思理。
units.en: When grown he was tranquil and quiet, sparing in social dealings, fond of learning and possessed of reflective understanding.
units.literal: When grown he was tranquil and quiet, sparing in social dealings, fond of learning and possessed of reflective understanding.

units.zh: 善隸書，爲當時楷法，南鄉范雲、樂安任昉，並稱賞之。
units.en: He was skilled in clerical script and was the standard model of the age; Fan Yun of Nanyang and Ren Fang of Le'an both praised and admired him.
units.literal: He was skilled in clerical script and was the standard model of the age; Fan Yun of Nanyang and Ren Fang of Le'an both praised and admired him.

units.zh: 高祖與叡少舊故，以女妻鈞，卽永興公主也。
units.en: The emperor and Rui had been old friends from youth; he gave his daughter in marriage to Jun—she was the Princess of Yongxing.
units.literal: The High Ancestor and Rui had been old friends from youth; he gave his daughter in marriage to Jun—she was the Princess of Yongxing.

units.zh: 天監初，拜駙馬都尉，起家秘書郎、太子舍人、司徒主簿、秘書丞。
units.en: Early in the Tianjian era he was appointed commandant of the horse guards for the imperial son-in-law and began his career as secretary, attendant of the heir apparent, chief clerk of the Secretariat, and director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianjian he was appointed Commandant of the Horse Guards for the Imperial Son-in-Law and began his career as Secretary, Attendant of the Heir Apparent, Chief Clerk of the Secretariat, and Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 鈞在職，啓校定秘閣四部書，更爲目錄。
units.en: While in office Jun memorialized to collate and fix the four categories of books in the secret archive and compile a new catalogue.
units.literal: While in office Jun memorialized to collate and fix the four categories of books in the Secret Archive and compile a new catalogue.

units.zh: 又受詔料檢西省法書古迹，別爲品目。
units.en: He also received an imperial order to examine and sort the model calligraphy and ancient works in the western office, setting them apart in categories.
units.literal: He also received an order to examine and sort the model calligraphy and ancient works in the Western Office, setting them apart in categories.

units.zh: 遷驃騎從事中郎，中書郎、太子家令、掌東宮書記。
units.en: He was promoted to aide-de-camp to the rapid cavalry general, director of the Secretariat, steward of the heir apparent's household, and oversaw the Eastern Palace records.
units.literal: He was transferred to Aide-de-Camp to the Rapid Cavalry General, Director of the Secretariat, Steward of the Heir Apparent's Household, and oversaw the Eastern Palace records.

units.zh: 頃之，遷給事黃門侍郎、中庶子、尚書吏部郎、司徒左長史，侍中。
units.en: Soon he was promoted to Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, Junior Mentor, Personnel Section Gentleman in the Masters of Writing, left chief clerk to the Minister over the Masses, and Attendant-in-Ordinary.
units.literal: Shortly thereafter he was transferred to Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, Junior Tutor, Director of the Ministry of Personnel in the Secretariat, Left Chief Clerk of the Secretariat, and Attendant-in-Chief.

units.zh: 東宮置學士，復以鈞爲之。
units.en: When the Eastern Palace appointed scholars, Jun was again chosen.
units.literal: When the Eastern Palace appointed scholars, Jun was again chosen.

units.zh: 公事免。
units.en: He was dismissed on account of a public matter.
units.literal: He was dismissed on account of public business.

units.zh: 復爲中庶子，領國子博士、左驍騎將軍，博士如故。
units.en: He again became junior tutor, concurrently erudite of the Imperial University and general of the left rapid cavalry, with erudite duties as before.
units.literal: He again became Junior Tutor, concurrently Erudite of the Imperial University and General of the Left Rapid Cavalry, with erudite duties as before.

units.zh: 出爲明威將軍、臨川內史。
units.en: He left the capital as general of illustrious prestige and internal administrator of Linchuan.
units.literal: He went out as General of Illustrious Prestige and Internal Administrator of Linchuan.

units.zh: 鈞體羸多疾，閉閤臥治，而百姓化其德，劫盜皆奔出境。
units.en: Jun's body was frail and he suffered many illnesses; he shut his doors and governed from bed, yet the common people were transformed by his virtue and bandits all fled beyond the borders.
units.literal: Jun's body was frail and he suffered many illnesses; he shut his doors and governed from bed, yet the common people were transformed by his virtue and bandits all fled beyond the borders.

units.zh: 嘗禽劫帥，不加考掠，但和言誚責。
units.en: Once he captured a bandit chief and did not apply torture, but only with gentle words reproached and blamed him.
units.literal: Once he captured a bandit chief and did not apply torture, but only with gentle words reproached and blamed him.

units.zh: 劫帥稽顙乞改過，鈞便命遣之，後遂爲善人。
units.en: The bandit chief knocked his forehead to the ground begging to reform his faults; Jun then ordered him released, and afterward he became a good man.
units.literal: The bandit chief knocked his forehead to the ground begging to reform his faults; Jun then ordered him released, and afterward he became a good man.

units.zh: 郡舊多山瘧，更暑必動，自鈞在任，郡境無復瘧疾。
units.en: The commandery had long suffered much mountain malaria; whenever the season turned hot it would flare up, but from the time Jun held office there was no more malaria within the commandery borders.
units.literal: The commandery had long suffered much mountain malaria; whenever the season turned hot it would flare up, but from the time Jun held office there was no more malaria within the commandery borders.

units.zh: 母憂去職，居喪過禮，昭明太子憂之，手書誡喻曰：「知比諸德，哀頓爲過，又所進殆無一溢，甚以酸耿。
units.en: He left office to mourn his mother and observed mourning beyond the rites. Crown Prince Zhaoming, concerned for him, wrote an admonition in his own hand: "I know your many virtues, but your grief has brought you too low, and you take scarcely even one measure of food. This causes me deep distress.
units.literal: He left office on account of his mother's mourning and exceeded the rites in his observance. Crown Prince Zhaoming was concerned and personally wrote an admonition: "I know your many virtues, but your grief has brought you too low, and what you consume scarcely amounts to one yi. This causes me deep distress.

units.zh: 迥然一身，宗奠是寄，毀而滅性，聖教所不許。
units.en: You stand alone in the world; the ancestral sacrifices depend on you. To destroy yourself and extinguish your nature is what the sage's teaching does not permit.
units.literal: You stand alone in the world; the ancestral sacrifices depend on you. To destroy yourself and extinguish your nature is what the sage's teaching does not permit.

units.zh: 宜微自遣割，俯存禮制，穀粥果蔬，少加勉強。
units.en: You should slightly restrain yourself and bow to preserve the rites; grain porridge, fruits, and vegetables—exert yourself a little to take them.
units.literal: You should slightly restrain yourself and bow to preserve the rites; grain porridge, fruits, and vegetables—exert yourself a little to take them.

units.zh: 憂懷旣深，指故有及，並令繆道臻口具。」
units.en: My concern is already deep; my meaning reaches back to former times, and I have also ordered Miu Daozhen to deliver this orally in full."
units.literal: My concern is already deep; my meaning reaches back to former times, and I have also ordered Miu Daozhen to deliver this orally in full."

units.zh: 鈞答曰：「奉賜手令，並繆道臻宣旨，伏讀感咽，肝心塗地。
units.en: Jun replied, "I have received your handwritten order and Miu Daozhen's announcement of your intent; bowing, I read it and am choked with feeling, my liver and heart laid upon the ground.
units.literal: Jun replied, "I have received your handwritten order and Miu Daozhen's announcement of your intent; bowing, I read it and am choked with feeling, my liver and heart laid upon the ground.

units.zh: 小人無情，動不及禮，但稟生尫劣，假推年歲，罪戾所鐘，復加橫疾。
units.en: This petty man is without feeling; my movements do not reach the rites, but I was endowed with life weak and inferior, falsely advanced in years, crimes and faults heaped upon me, and again sudden severe illness was added.
units.literal: This petty man is without feeling; my movements do not reach the rites, but I was endowed with life weak and inferior, falsely advanced in years, crimes and faults heaped upon me, and again sudden severe illness added.

units.zh: 頃者綿微，守盡晷漏，目亂玄黃，心迷哀樂，惟救危苦，未能以遠理自製。
units.en: Recently I have been frail and slight, keeping watch through every measure of day and night; my eyes are confused by black and yellow, my heart lost between grief and joy; I only rescue myself from peril and suffering and have not been able to restrain myself by distant principle.
units.literal: Recently I have been frail and slight, keeping watch through every measure of day and night; my eyes are confused by black and yellow, my heart lost between grief and joy; I only rescue myself from peril and suffering and have not been able to restrain myself by distant principle.

units.zh: 姜桂之滋，實聞前典，不避粱肉，復忝今慈，臣亦何人，降此憂愍。
units.en: The nourishment of ginger and cassia—I have truly heard of it in former canons; not avoiding millet and meat, I again receive your present kindness—what sort of man am I that you lower this concern and compassion upon me.
units.literal: The nourishment of ginger and cassia—I have truly heard of it in former canons; not avoiding millet and meat, I again receive your present kindness—what sort of man am I that you lower this concern and compassion upon me?

units.zh: 謹當循復聖言，思自補續，如脫申延，實由亭造。」
units.en: I shall respectfully follow and restore the sage's words and think to repair and continue myself; if I escape and prolong my life, it will truly be by your pavilion's making."
units.literal: I shall respectfully follow and restore the sage's words and think to repair and continue myself; if I escape and prolong my life, it will truly be by your pavilion's making."

units.zh: 服闋，遷五兵尚書，猶以頓瘵經時，不堪拜受，乃更授散騎常侍、領步兵校尉，侍東宮。
units.en: When mourning ended he was promoted to director of the five armies in the Secretariat, but because of prolonged severe illness he could not bear to accept the appointment on bended knee; he was therefore given instead regular attendant of the scattered cavalry and colonel of the foot soldiers, attending the Eastern Palace.
units.literal: When mourning ended he was transferred to Director of the Five Armies in the Secretariat, but because of prolonged severe illness over time he could not bear to accept the appointment on bended knee; he was therefore given instead Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry and Colonel of the Foot Soldiers, attending the Eastern Palace.

units.zh: 尋改領中庶子。
units.en: Soon he was changed to concurrently serve as junior tutor.
units.literal: Soon he was changed to concurrently serve as Junior Tutor.

units.zh: 昭明太子薨，官屬罷，又領右遊擊，除國子祭酒，常侍如故。
units.en: When Crown Prince Zhaoming passed away the official staff was dismissed; Jun again concurrently served as right mobile strike general, was appointed libationer of the Imperial University, and retained his regular attendant post as before.
units.literal: When Crown Prince Zhaoming passed away the official staff was dismissed; Jun again concurrently served as Right Mobile Strike General, was appointed Libationer of the Imperial University, and retained his regular attendant post as before.

units.zh: 中大通四年，卒，時年四十九。
units.en: In the fourth year of Zhongdatong he died at the age of forty-nine.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Zhongdatong he died, aged forty-nine.

units.zh: 諡曰貞子。
units.en: His posthumous title was Zhenzi, "The Upright."
units.literal: His posthumous title was Zhenzi.

units.zh: 二子：構，渥。
units.en: He had two sons: Gou and Wo.
units.literal: He had two sons: Gou and Wo.

units.zh: 陸襄字師卿，吳郡吳人也。
units.en: Lu Xiang, styled Shiqing, came from Wu county in Wu commandery.
units.literal: Lu Xiang, styled Shiqing, was a man of Wu county in Wu commandery.

units.zh: 父閑，齊始安王遙光揚州治中。
units.en: His father Xian had been administrator of Yangzhou under the Prince of Shi'an of Qi, Xiao Yaoguang.
units.literal: His father Xian was Administrator of Yangzhou under the Prince of Shi'an of Qi, Xiao Yaoguang.

units.zh: 永元末，遙光據東府作亂，或勸閑去之。
units.en: At the end of the Yongyuan era Yaoguang seized the Eastern Palace and raised rebellion; some urged Xian to leave him.
units.literal: At the end of the Yongyuan era Yaoguang seized the Eastern Palace and raised rebellion; some urged Xian to leave him.

units.zh: 閑曰：「吾爲人吏，何所逃死。」
units.en: Xian said, "I am a man's officer—where could I flee from death?"
units.literal: Xian said, "I am a man's officer—where could I flee from death?"

units.zh: 臺軍攻陷城，閑見執，將刑，第二子絳求代死，不獲，遂以身蔽刃，刑者俱害之。
units.en: The imperial army attacked and took the city; Xian was seized and about to be executed. His second son Jiang begged to die in his place but was not permitted; he then shielded the blade with his body, and the executioners killed them both.
units.literal: The imperial army attacked and took the city; Xian was seized and about to be executed. His second son Jiang begged to die in his place but was not permitted; he then shielded the blade with his body, and the executioners killed them both.

units.zh: 襄痛父兄之酷，喪過於禮，服釋後猶若居憂。
units.en: Xiang grieved the cruelty done to his father and brother; his mourning exceeded the rites, and after the mourning garments were removed he still seemed to be in grief.
units.literal: Xiang grieved the cruelty done to his father and brother; his mourning exceeded the rites, and after the mourning garments were removed he still seemed to be in grief.

units.zh: 天監三年，都官尚書范岫表薦襄，起家擢拜著作佐郎，除永寧令。
units.en: In the third year of Tianjian the director of the capital office, Fan Xiu, memorialized to recommend Xiang; he began his career with direct appointment as assistant gentleman author, then was appointed magistrate of Yongning.
units.literal: In the third year of Tianjian the Director of the Capital Office, Fan Xiu, memorialized to recommend Xiang; he began his career with direct appointment as Assistant Gentleman Author, then was appointed Magistrate of Yongning.

units.zh: 秩滿，累遷司空臨川王法曹，外兵，輕車廬陵王記室參軍。
units.en: When his term ended he rose through the legal bureau under the minister of works, Prince of Linchuan, then outer army, then recorder on the staff of the light chariots general, Prince of Luling.
units.literal: When his term ended he was repeatedly transferred to the Legal Bureau under the Minister of Works, Prince of Linchuan, then Outer Army, then Recorder on the staff of the Light Chariots General, Prince of Luling.

units.zh: 昭明太子聞襄業行，啓高祖引與游處，除太子洗馬，遷中舍人，並掌管記。
units.en: Crown Prince Zhaoming heard of Xiang's conduct and achievement and memorialized the emperor to bring him into association and companionship; he was appointed groom of the heir apparent's household, promoted to palace attendant, and jointly managed the records.
units.literal: Crown Prince Zhaoming heard of Xiang's conduct and achievement and memorialized the High Ancestor to bring him into association and companionship; he was appointed Groom of the Heir Apparent's Household, transferred to Palace Attendant, and jointly managed the records.

units.zh: 出爲揚州治中，襄父終此官，固辭職，高祖不許，聽與府司馬換廨居之。
units.en: He went out as administrator of Yangzhou; Xiang's father had died in this office, and he firmly declined the post. The emperor did not permit it but allowed him to exchange residences with the prefectural marshal.
units.literal: He went out as Administrator of Yangzhou; Xiang's father had died in this office, and he firmly declined the post. The High Ancestor did not permit it but allowed him to exchange residences with the prefectural marshal.

units.zh: 昭明太子敬耆老，襄母年將八十，與蕭琛、傅昭、陸杲每月常遣存問，加賜珍羞衣服。
units.en: Crown Prince Zhaoming respected the aged; Xiang's mother was nearing eighty, and together with Xiao Chen, Fu Zhao, and Lu Gao he monthly sent inquiries after her welfare and additionally bestowed delicacies and clothing.
units.literal: Crown Prince Zhaoming respected the aged; Xiang's mother was nearing eighty, and together with Xiao Chen, Fu Zhao, and Lu Gao he monthly sent inquiries after her welfare and additionally bestowed delicacies and clothing.

units.zh: 襄母嘗卒患心痛，醫方須三升粟漿，是時冬月，日又逼暮，求索無所。
units.en: Xiang's mother once suddenly suffered heart pain; the medical prescription required three sheng of millet gruel. It was then winter, and the day was already nearing dusk; they sought everywhere and found nothing.
units.literal: Xiang's mother once suddenly suffered heart pain; the medical prescription required three sheng of millet gruel. It was then winter, and the day was already nearing dusk; they sought everywhere and found nothing.

units.zh: 忽有老人詣門貨漿，量如方劑，始欲酬直，無何失之，時以襄孝感所致也。
units.en: Suddenly an old man came to the door selling gruel; the amount matched the prescription. Just as they were about to pay the price, he vanished without trace; men of the time attributed it to Xiang's filial feeling moving heaven.
units.literal: Suddenly an old man came to the door selling gruel; the amount matched the prescription. Just as they were about to pay the price, he vanished without trace; men of the time attributed it to Xiang's filial feeling moving heaven.

units.zh: 累遷國子博士，太子家令，復掌管記，母憂去職。
units.en: He rose through erudite of the Imperial University and steward of the heir apparent's household, again managing the records, then left office to mourn his mother.
units.literal: He was repeatedly transferred to Erudite of the Imperial University and Steward of the Heir Apparent's Household, again managing the records, then left office on account of his mother's mourning.

units.zh: 襄年已五十，毀頓過禮，太子憂之，日遣使誡喻。
units.en: Xiang was already fifty; his grief and prostration exceeded the rites, and the crown prince was concerned and daily sent envoys to admonish and instruct him.
units.literal: Xiang was already fifty; his grief and prostration exceeded the rites, and the crown prince was concerned and daily sent envoys to admonish and instruct him.

units.zh: 服闋，除太子中庶子，復掌管記。
units.en: When mourning ended he was appointed junior tutor of the heir apparent and again managed the records.
units.literal: When mourning ended he was appointed Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and again managed the records.

units.zh: 中大通三年，昭明太子薨，官屬罷，妃蔡氏別居金華宮，以襄爲中散大夫、領步兵校尉、金華宮家令、知金華宮事。
units.en: In the third year of Zhongdatong Crown Prince Zhaoming passed away and the official staff was dismissed; the consort of the Cai clan lived separately in Jinhua Palace, and Xiang was made grand master of palace leisure, colonel of the foot soldiers, steward of Jinhua Palace, and overseer of Jinhua Palace affairs.
units.literal: In the third year of Zhongdatong Crown Prince Zhaoming passed away and the official staff was dismissed; the consort of the Cai clan lived separately in Jinhua Palace, and Xiang was made Grand Master of Palace Leisure, Colonel of the Foot Soldiers, Steward of Jinhua Palace, and overseer of Jinhua Palace affairs.

units.zh: 七年，出爲鄱陽內史。
units.en: In the seventh year he left the capital as internal administrator of Poyang.
units.literal: In the seventh year he went out as Internal Administrator of Poyang.

units.zh: 先是，郡民鮮于琛服食修道法，嘗入山采藥，拾得五色幡眊，又於地中得石璽，竊怪之。
units.en: Earlier, a man of the commandery, Xianyu Chen, ingested elixirs and practiced the Way of cultivation; once entering the mountains to gather herbs he picked up a five-colored banner and cap, and also obtained a stone seal from the ground, privately marveling at it.
units.literal: Earlier, a man of the commandery, Xianyu Chen, ingested elixirs and practiced the Way of cultivation; once entering the mountains to gather herbs he picked up a five-colored banner and cap, and also obtained a stone seal from the ground, privately marveling at it.

units.zh: 琛先與妻別室，望琛所處，常有異氣，益以爲神。
units.en: Chen had earlier lived in a separate room from his wife; gazing toward where Chen dwelt there was often a strange aura, and they increasingly regarded him as divine.
units.literal: Chen had earlier lived in a separate room from his wife; gazing toward where Chen dwelt there was often a strange aura, and they increasingly regarded him as divine.

units.zh: 大同元年，遂結其門徒，殺廣晉令王筠，號上願元年，署置官屬。
units.en: In the first year of Datong he then rallied his disciples, killed the magistrate of Guangjin Wang Yun, proclaimed the era name Shangyuan, and appointed official staff.
units.literal: In the first year of Datong he then rallied his disciples, killed the Magistrate of Guangjin Wang Yun, proclaimed the era name Shangyuan, and appointed official staff.

units.zh: 其黨轉相誑惑，有衆萬餘人。
units.en: His faction in turn deceived and misled one another, until they had a host of more than ten thousand men.
units.literal: His faction in turn deceived and misled one another, until they had a host of more than ten thousand men.

units.zh: 將出攻郡，襄先已帥民吏修城隍，爲備禦，及賊至，連戰破之，生獲琛，餘衆逃散。
units.en: About to march out to attack the commandery, Xiang had already led the people and officials in repairing the walls and moat for defense; when the rebels arrived he defeated them in successive battles, captured Chen alive, and the remaining host fled and scattered.
units.literal: About to march out to attack the commandery, Xiang had already led the people and officials in repairing the walls and moat for defense; when the rebels arrived he defeated them in successive battles, captured Chen alive, and the remaining host fled and scattered.

units.zh: 時鄰郡豫章、安成等守宰，案治黨與，因求賄貨，皆不得其實，或有善人盡室離禍，惟襄郡部枉直無濫。
units.en: At that time the defending officials of neighboring commanderies such as Yuzhang and Ancheng, in investigating and punishing accomplices, sought bribes on the pretext and none obtained the truth; sometimes good men had their whole households swept into calamity—only in Xiang's commandery were the wronged and the upright distinguished without excess.
units.literal: At that time the defending officials of neighboring commanderies such as Yuzhang and Ancheng, in investigating and punishing accomplices, sought bribes on the pretext and none obtained the truth; sometimes good men had their whole households swept into calamity—only in Xiang's commandery were the wronged and the upright distinguished without excess.

units.zh: 民作歌曰：「鮮于平後善惡分，民無枉死，賴有陸君。」
units.en: The people composed a song: "After Xianyu was pacified, good and evil were divided; the people died without injustice—thanks to Lord Lu."
units.literal: The people composed a song: "After Xianyu was pacified, good and evil were divided; the people died without injustice—thanks to Lord Lu."

units.zh: 又有彭李二家，先因忿爭，遂相誣告，襄引入內室，不加責誚，但和言解喻之，二人感恩，深自咎悔。
units.en: There were also the Peng and Li households, who first quarreled in anger and then accused each other falsely. Xiang brought them into his inner chamber, applied no blame or reproach, but only with gentle words explained and persuaded them; the two men were grateful and deeply repented their faults.
units.literal: There were also the Peng and Li households, who first quarreled in anger and then accused each other falsely. Xiang brought them into his inner chamber, applied no blame or reproach, but only with gentle words explained and persuaded them; the two men were grateful and deeply repented their faults.

units.zh: 乃爲設酒食，令其盡歡，酒罷，同載而還，因相親厚。
units.en: He then set out wine and food for them and had them enjoy themselves fully; when the wine ended they returned in the same carriage and thereby became close and warm.
units.literal: He then set out wine and food for them and had them enjoy themselves fully; when the wine ended they returned in the same carriage and thereby became close and warm.

units.zh: 民又歌曰：「陸君政，無怨家，鬥旣罷，仇共車。」
units.en: The people again sang: "Lord Lu's governance—no families bearing grudges; when the fight ended, foes shared a carriage."
units.literal: The people again sang: "Lord Lu's governance—no families bearing grudges; when the fight ended, foes shared a carriage."

units.zh: 在政六年，郡中大治，民李睍等四百二十人詣闕拜表，陳襄德化，求於郡立碑，降勑許之。
units.en: In office for six years the commandery was greatly well governed; the commoner Li Xian and 420 others went to the capital to present a memorial at court, stating Xiang's moral transformation, and requested that a stele be erected in the commandery; an edict was issued granting permission.
units.literal: In office for six years the commandery was greatly well governed; the commoner Li Xian and 420 others went to the capital to present a memorial at court, stating Xiang's moral transformation, and requested that a stele be erected in the commandery; an edict was issued granting permission.

units.zh: 又表乞留襄，襄固求還，徵爲吏部郎，遷秘書監，領揚州大中正。
units.en: They also memorialized begging to retain Xiang, but Xiang firmly sought to return; he was summoned as director of the Ministry of Personnel, promoted to director of the Secretariat, and concurrently senior rectifier of Yangzhou.
units.literal: They also memorialized begging to retain Xiang, but Xiang firmly sought to return; he was summoned as Director of the Ministry of Personnel, transferred to Director of the Secretariat, and concurrently Senior Rectifier of Yangzhou.

units.zh: 太清元年，遷度支尚書，中正如故。
units.en: In the first year of Taiqing he was promoted to director of the revenue section and retained his rectifier duties as before.
units.literal: In the first year of Taiqing he was transferred to Director of the Revenue Section and retained his rectifier duties as before.

units.zh: 二年，侯景舉兵圍宮城，以襄直侍中省。
units.en: In the second year Hou Jing raised troops and besieged the palace city; Xiang was assigned to serve directly in the attendant-in-chief office.
units.literal: In the second year Hou Jing raised troops and besieged the palace city; Xiang was assigned to serve directly in the Attendant-in-Chief Office.

units.zh: 三年三月，城陷，襄逃還吳。
units.en: In the third year, third month, the city fell; Xiang fled back to Wu.
units.literal: In the third year, third month, the city fell; Xiang fled back to Wu.

units.zh: 賊尋寇東境，沒吳郡。
units.en: The rebels soon raided the eastern borders and overran Wu commandery.
units.literal: The rebels soon raided the eastern borders and overran Wu commandery.

units.zh: 景將宋子仙進攻錢塘，會海鹽人陸黯舉義，有衆數千人，夜出襲郡，殺偽太守蘇單于，推襄行郡事。
units.en: Jing's general Song Zixian advanced to attack Qiantang; at that time Lu An of Haiyan raised righteous arms with a host of several thousand men, sallied out by night to strike the commandery, killed the false administrator Su Danyu, and pushed Xiang to act in commandery affairs.
units.literal: Jing's general Song Zixian advanced to attack Qiantang; at that time Lu An of Haiyan raised righteous arms with a host of several thousand men, sallied out by night to strike the commandery, killed the false administrator Su Danyu, and pushed Xiang to act in commandery affairs.
